citation.wording: State and local real estate taxes

sources.note:
THE ONE LINE WITH NO CHECK, AND THE ONLY ONE WITH NO WHOLE. A lender's escrowed real estate tax (Form 1098 box 10) and the county's own bill are ONE PAYMENT reported on two kinds of paper — and the two amounts NEED NOT AGREE: the lender reports what it disbursed in the calendar year, the county bills an instalment year, and a taxpayer may have paid one bill direct and escrowed another. So nothing can check them and nothing may strike one out. Both are marked, both are counted as the documents state them, and a person settles it. Report, never repair.

`grain: schedule` because this line is the RETURN's, not an activity's: the residence has no Schedule E column to sit in, and the rental half of the same 1098 forks to Schedule E 16, which does have an activity and does have a check.
